Privacy Policy

Last updated: January 15, 2025

1. Introduction

Fetchlab ("we", "our", "us") is committed to protecting your privacy. This Privacy Policy explains how we collect, use, and safeguard your information when you use the Fetchlab iOS application and related services.

2. Information We Collect

Account Information

When you create an account, we collect your email address and display name. We use this information to provide and manage your account.

Usage Analytics

We collect anonymized usage data to improve the app experience. This includes feature usage patterns, crash reports, and performance metrics. We do not track individual API requests or response content.

API Data

Your API requests, responses, collections, and environments are stored locally on your device by default. If you enable Cloud Sync (Pro/Team plans), this data is end-to-end encrypted before being transmitted to our servers.

3. Third-Party Services

  • Supabase — Authentication and cloud data storage. Data is encrypted at rest.
  • RevenueCat — Subscription management and billing. We share anonymized purchase data only.
  • TelemetryDeck — Privacy-first analytics. No personal data is collected.

4. Data Encryption & Storage

All cloud-synced data is encrypted using AES-256-GCM encryption before leaving your device. Encryption keys are derived from your account credentials and never transmitted to our servers. We cannot read your API data.

5. Your Rights

You have the right to:

  • Access your personal data
  • Export your collections and data
  • Request deletion of your account and all associated data
  • Opt out of analytics collection

To exercise any of these rights, contact us at privacy@fetchlab.dev.

6. Data Retention

We retain your account data for as long as your account is active. When you delete your account, all associated data is permanently deleted within 30 days.

7. Children's Privacy

Fetchlab is not directed at children under 13. We do not knowingly collect personal information from children.

8. Changes to This Policy

We may update this Privacy Policy from time to time. We will notify you of any material changes via the app or email.

9. Contact

If you have any questions about this Privacy Policy, please contact us at:

privacy@fetchlab.dev
